section_titles.sec01-name-address-records-road-test: Name and address changes, military and designations, motor vehicle records, legal presence, road test and test vehicle

section_titles.sec03-license-classes-permits-graduated: Classes of licenses, instruction permits, graduated license restrictions and penalties, parent/guardian approval, Selective Service, operator license (Class D)
section_titles.sec04-before-you-drive-belts-child-seats: Section 1 Before You Drive: required working equipment, tire safety, safety belt law, child restraints and air bags, 511 travel information, vehicle checks, secured loads, brakes
section_titles.sec05-equipment-defensive-driving-scanni: Remaining required equipment (head restraints, muffler, emissions, windshield, mirrors, horn, lights); Section 2 defensive driving, attitude, distractions, steering, scanning
section_titles.sec06-space-cushion-signaling-passing: Positioning, cushion of space and following distance, entering and crossing traffic, communicating and signaling, passing
section_titles.sec07-no-passing-roundabouts-parking: No-passing rules, roundabouts, diverging diamond interchanges, parking, accessible parking, backing, parallel parking, parking on a hill
section_titles.sec08-prohibited-parking-freeway-driving: Emergency and prohibited parking, entering and exiting freeways, lane use, gore area, stopping on the freeway, HOV lanes and freeway restrictions
section_titles.sec09-signal-lights-intersections-right-: Section 3: signal lights and arrows, inoperative signals, controlled and uncontrolled intersections, right-of-way, pedestrians
section_titles.sec10-pedestrian-rules-turns-emergency-v: Pedestrian rules, alleys and driveways, left turns, U-turns, red-light running, emergency vehicles, funerals, school buses and school zones, speed limits
section_titles.sec11-speed-adjustment-traffic-signs: Special speed limit areas, adjusting speed, impeding traffic, regulatory and warning sign shapes and colors, school crossing and railroad signs
section_titles.sec12-guide-signs-work-zones-pavement-ma: Guide and route signs, mile posts, work zones and flaggers, pavement markings and line colors, painted curbs
section_titles.sec13-curbs-lanes-turning-rules: Curb colors, one-way streets, use of lanes, reversible lanes, rules for right turns, right on red and left turns
section_titles.sec14-two-way-left-turn-light-rail-walki: Two-way left-turn lanes, light rail, train approaching and combined U-turn signs, safe walking and bike riding
section_titles.sec15-sharing-road-bicycles-motorcycles-: Section 4: sharing the road with bicyclists, motorcycles, trucks and slow-moving vehicles
section_titles.sec16-braking-stopping-weather-dust-stor: Section 5: braking and stopping distances, open-road driving, sun glare, wind, dust storms, rain
section_titles.sec17-floods-fog-snow-night-wrong-way: Flooded roads and emergency-response liability, fog, snow and ice, headlight use, low visibility, night driving, wrong-way drivers
section_titles.sec18-impairment-road-rage-medical-fatig: Alcohol, marijuana and drugs, open container, tolerance, providing alcohol to minors, road rage, emotions and health, medical restrictions, drowsy driving, revocation
section_titles.sec19-suspension-points-penalties: Vehicle impound, suspension and traffic school, violation points, driving on a suspended or revoked license, criminal citations, ticket enforcement, nitrous oxide
section_titles.sec20-dui-penalties-ignition-interlock: Altered or fictitious license, implied consent and DUI, DUI / extreme / aggravated DUI penalties, certified ignition interlock, hearings
section_titles.sec21-vehicle-emergencies-avoiding-crash: Section 6: tire failure, fire, overheating, power steering, headlight and brake failure, avoiding crashes, compromising, debris and animals
section_titles.sec22-crash-procedures-traffic-stops: Crash reporting and quick clearance; Section 7: what to do when stopped by law enforcement
